# Retail analytics that respects shoppers.

> Source-visible, privacy-first retail analytics prototype: door counts joined to POS sales for daily conversion. SKU-gap and experiment screens are demo data.

Free to use and source visible (all rights reserved). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

## Pages

- The tool is not published on the public site (its docs app is passcode-gated); run it from source.
